title: Sweet Kenyan Grilled Potato
description: A flavorful and aromatic dish from Kenya, featuring grilled potatoes with a hint of sweetness.
instructions: Cut potatoes and sweet potatoes into 1-inch wedges.
In a bowl, mix together Kenyan spices, salt, and black pepper.
Add the potato wedges to the spice mixture and toss to coat.
Brush the grill with olive oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the potato wedges for 5-7 minutes per side, or until tender and slightly charred.
Brush the sweet potatoes with olive oil and grill for 5-7 minutes per side, or until tender.
Drizzle with kissed lemon juice and serve hot.
